summary: Iter 14: verified Google Play permission fix (removal of READ_MEDIA_IMAGES from /app/frontend/app.json) via a dedicated pytest suite (17 tests, 16 passed + 1 skipped, 0 failures). PRIMARY WIN CONDITION MET: android.permissions is exactly ['ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION','ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION'] and the string 'READ_MEDIA_IMAGES' (also READ_MEDIA_VIDEO / READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE / WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) does not appear anywhere in app.json. SECONDARY WIN CONDITION MET: plugins array contains ['expo-image-picker', {photosPermission:false, cameraPermission:false, microphonePermission:false}] so the config plugin will not auto-inject any Android media permission into the merged AndroidManifest.xml at prebuild time. iOS regression preserved: ios.infoPlist still declares NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription and NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription so iOS builds keep the photo-library description string. Backend regression sanity: /api/health, /api/categories, /api/products, /api/auth/login (customer +355695808480 / 123456), and /api/admin/auth/login (+355690000001 / admin123) all return 200 with expected token+user payloads. Public /api/offers path was 404 in this env and was skipped (offers are consumed via /api/admin/offers per prior iterations — non-blocking). Frontend smoke: web preview boots cleanly with no red screen and no runtime errors; onboarding → /login flow renders correctly; /complete-profile is auth-gated and redirects to /login as expected (matches prior iteration 13 behavior). The image-picker consumer code paths (launchImageLibraryAsync in complete-profile.tsx, admin/offers.tsx, admin/products.tsx) were NOT modified by this fix and were previously validated in earlier iterations; on Android 13+ launchImageLibraryAsync uses the system Photo Picker automatically with no runtime permission grant, so removing READ_MEDIA_IMAGES has no functional impact on the picker.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json android.permissions is minimal and correct — only FINE + COARSE location, both required for the map-based delivery-address picker.

expo-image-picker plugin config using {photosPermission:false, cameraPermission:false, microphonePermission:false} is the modern Expo v17 pattern to suppress config-plugin auto-injection of READ_MEDIA_IMAGES / READ_MEDIA_VIDEO / CAMERA / RECORD_AUDIO — matches expo-image-picker docs.
package.json pins expo-image-picker to ~17.0.11 which routes launchImageLibraryAsync through the Android Photo Picker on Android 13+ automatically — no code changes needed on the consumer screens.
ios.infoPlist still declares NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription even though the Android permission was removed — this is correct because iOS still needs the description string for App Store review.

None of the three image-picker consumer files (complete-profile.tsx, admin/offers.tsx, admin/products.tsx) needed to change — they call requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync() before launchImageLibraryAsync(), and on Android 13+ that permission request is a no-op (returns granted) since the Photo Picker doesn't require it.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Google Play permission fix is a pure static-config change to /app/frontend/app.json. To re-verify at any time: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_app_json_permissions_iter14.py -v` (17 tests, ~2s). The AAB itself is generated by the deploy pipeline from app.json — after this change `aapt dump permissions app.aab` should NOT list android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES. If a future feature needs full media library access (not just picker), reintroduce the permission via `android.permissions` AND note the justification for Play Store review; otherwise keep using expo-image-picker's Photo Picker.
rca_of_issue: N/A — fix verified. Original Play Store rejection: app.json declared READ_MEDIA_IMAGES which triggered Play's new policy requiring apps with 'one-time or infrequent' media access to use the Android Photo Picker instead. Fix: (a) removed READ_MEDIA_IMAGES from android.permissions leaving only [FINE, COARSE] location, (b) added expo-image-picker plugin config with photosPermission=false, cameraPermission=false, microphonePermission=false to prevent the config plugin from auto-re-injecting the permission during prebuild. expo-image-picker v17's launchImageLibraryAsync uses the Android Photo Picker (system UI, no runtime permission needed) on Android 13+ automatically, so the customer avatar picker (/complete-profile), admin banner-offer image (/admin/offers), and admin product image (/admin/products) continue to work identically. iOS NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription preserved via manual ios.infoPlist entry.
